measured: frame_ms: wall time on the UI thread (Instant, so time the thread was preempted counts) from the start of the window root's render (TermView::render) to the end of TermElement::paint, for every frame while the feed ran; it does NOT include gpui's scene submission or the GPU present after paint. latency_ms: from the end of the parse of the oldest bytes a frame shows to that frame's render start (also not the present). late_frames: frames whose latency is over one vsync (16.667 ms), i.e. output waited through a vsync with no render started for it; output_unshown_at_end: parsed bytes no frame had shown 200 ms after the feed ended. interval_ms: render start to render start, counted when the frame's bytes were parsed within one vsync of the previous render start. max is exact (to the microsecond), p99/p50 nearest rank. ui_lock_*: the frame's one Term lock in prepaint (wait to acquire, hold); feeder_lock_*: per parse_chunk bytes. checksum: FNV-1a of scrollback+screen text and of every cell (char, colors, flags), the pane's Term vs a headless Term fed the recorded bytes with the same resizes
